hero.headline: Local marketing people can see, scan, and step into.
hero.sub: Epispace bundles short-form video, on-street AR experiences, and original character IP into one offer — built for commercial districts, festivals, and local brands. Based in Vancouver, founded in Jeju.
hero.caption: Lee Jung-seob Street, Seogwipo
hero.alt: A person holding a phone up in front of Lee Jung-seob’s room in Seogwipo

services.title: Video that makes people stop — and visit.
services.body: Creator-led short-form video (Reels · TikTok · Shorts) that turns local places into discoveries. Led by a Vancouver discovery creator whose local-brand reels reach tens of thousands of organic views.
services.alt: Epispace tent by the sea at the Seogwipo youth camp

services.title: The street tells its story. No app needed.
services.body: WebAR story trails and AR photo zones that run in the browser — scan an NFC tag or QR at the spot, and the place's hidden story appears. Built for plazas, shopping streets, and festival sites.
services.alt: WebAR screens from the Lee Jung-seob Street trail

services.title: A character of your own — if you want one.
services.body: An original character gives a district or brand a face people remember after the campaign ends. Start with our Woongdee, or commission one made for your place. Optional, always — the marketing works without it.
services.alt: Woongdee looking up from a puddle on the floor
